definitions.realized: settle + exit, after normalizing each field to net fees using its fee_basis

fee_basis.net: The field already includes its fee. Do not subtract it again.
fee_basis.gross: Subtract the corresponding fee exactly once before adding to realized.

definitions.cash_out: Complete yes/no pairs = min(yes,no), including fractional pairs. Each pair pays 100 USD cents before fees. Unmatched legs receive no paired payout. revenue_includes_pairs declares whether revenue_cents already contains that payout. revenue_cents and cost_cents exclude fee_cents; fee_cents is an uncounted fee, deducted once. net_cents = revenue_cents + uncounted paired payout - cost_cents - fee_cents.
definitions.open_uncounted_fee_cents: Only fees not included in settle, exit, open mark or open exposure. Never repeat a counted fee.

numeric.input: Unformatted signed decimal strings, at most 6 fractional digits, absolute value <= 1000000. No exponent, whitespace, grouping, plus sign or negative zero. Null means missing; never coerce to zero.
numeric.computation: Exact fixed point, scale 1000000. No formatted string is a numeric input. Keep full precision through computation; round only for display.

money.display: ASCII $1,234.56 or -$1,234.56; rounded zero has no minus sign

ratio.display: multiply by 100 exactly once, round to 2 decimal places, trim trailing fractional zeros, append %

day.input: ISO 8601 Gregorian timestamps, years 2000 through 2099, seconds required, optional 1-3 millisecond digits, Z or explicit numeric offset. Offset magnitude <= 14:00.
day.label: Today UTC [YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z, YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z)
day.date_window_label: Every date-window label must show UTC and its explicit inclusive start and exclusive end.
day.presentation: Central, Eastern and browser locale may format timestamps only. They never change membership or the UTC range label.

null_propagation: A missing required operand makes only its dependent result null. A net settle/exit does not depend on its already-counted fee. Missing display values read Not reported. Invalid inputs refuse the whole operation.
